summary: Ephemeral bootstrapper failing: GCP SA creation denied + AWS assume-role session tag mismatch blocks private deploy
description: Issue summary: The ephemeral-service-account bootstrapper used by Private deployment onboarding is failing during automated provisioning. The controller attempts to create a short-lived GCP service account and then exchange credentials with our AWS assume-role chain. GCP returns a DENY on serviceAccount.create due to an organization-level deny constraint; simultaneously the AWS AssumeRole step requires a session tag 'env' which our token exchange flow is not supplying because the GCP SA creation never completes. Impact: new private deployments are stuck in 'initializing' and cannot attach dedicated GPU pools. A few recent onboards hit this (customer-facing but internal provisioning). Environment: prod-us-west private control plane and staging mirrors for verification.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger private deployment onboarding via infra bootstrapper (service: private-deploy-runner, job: create-ephemeral-sa).
Bootstrapper calls GCP IAM API: projects/-/serviceAccounts:create with payload including displayName and labels.
On create success, bootstrapper uploads key and initiates AWS STS AssumeRole chain with session tags: expects 'env' tag.
Observe failure path when org deny constraint present or when GCP create returns PERMISSION_DENIED.
Result: bootstrapper retries then times out, leaving deployment in initializing state.
logs: 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z private-bootstrapper ERROR create-service-account: googleapi: Error 403: Request had insufficient authentication scopes., forbidden
2026-03-10T14:12:04Z private-bootstrapper WARN attempt=3 skipping assume-role: ephemeral SA not created
2026-03-10T14:12:20Z sts-exchange ERROR AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity failed: Missing required session tag: env
investigation_notes: 03/10 15:00 - Confirmed error originates from organization Constraint 'constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountCreation' applied at folder level for project-parent-123 (applied via Terraform in infra-org).

03/10 16:20 - The bootstrapper is running with a delegating service account that has iam.serviceAccounts.create at project but org-level constraint overrides and denies creation. Reproducible in staging when the same policy is applied.

03/11 09:10 - AWS side: AssumeRole policy requires 'env' session tag by Condition: StringEquals: sts:TagKeys includes 'env' and Tag key-value must match caller's environment. Token exchange code path only populates tags on successful GCP SA + keyflow; since SA creation fails there are no tags.
03/11 10:00 - Hypothesis: two independent guardrails combined create a deadlock: GCP deny prevents SA creation, AWS assume-role enforces tags that are only set after SA creation.
comments: Evelyn Park 2026-03-10: Raised after customer onboarding retries failed; attached bootstrapper logs. Requesting priority triage.
Diego Morales 2026-03-10: Investigating org constraints and bootstrapper flow. PoC: manually creating SA in project as org-admin succeeds only when constraint is relaxed.

SRE-Oncall 2026-03-11: Temporary mitigation: we can run a manual one-off create using a privileged operator account and then annotate deployment to skip bootstrapper, but this is manual and not scalable.
Security-Infra 2026-03-11: Org deny constraint was introduced to prevent uncontrolled SA creation after an audit. We need an approved automation exception flow rather than blanket relax.

resolution: In progress: temporary manual workaround documented (operator SA creation + annotate deployment). Next steps: implement preflight check + JIT exception request flow in bootstrapper, and update org policy runbook. Security team to review exception design. Target: automated mitigation deployed to staging by 2026-03-18.
